stem: Which Venn diagram correctly represents the relationship between rational numbers and irrational numbers?

options.label: A
options.text: , because rational numbers and irrational numbers have no numbers in common

options.label: B
options.text: , because some irrational numbers are also rational numbers

options.label: C
options.text: , because all rational numbers are also irrational numbers

options.label: D
options.text: , because all irrational numbers are also rational numbers

visual_elements: A: Real numbers rectangle with two separate circles labeled 'Rational numbers' and 'Irrational numbers'.
B: Real numbers rectangle with two intersecting circles labeled 'Rational numbers' and 'Irrational numbers'.
C: Real numbers rectangle with one circle inside the other: larger 'Irrational numbers' containing smaller 'Rational numbers'.
D: Real numbers rectangle with one circle inside the other: larger 'Rational numbers' containing smaller 'Irrational numbers'.
